description: Enterprise software license agreement with a definitions table, license-tier entitlement matrix, fee schedule, and multi-level restriction clauses.
provenance: Modeled on the perpetual-plus-maintenance license agreements used by industrial software vendors (CAD, simulation, EDA), where entitlements are expressed as a tier matrix and use restrictions run to deep sub-clause numbering. Deliberately exercises a two-column definitions table, an entitlement matrix with column widths and centered checkmark-style cells, decimal clause numbering to three levels (7.2.1), nested letter lists, a footnoted export-control clause, and a fee schedule table with computed totals.

elements.text: In this Agreement, the following terms have the meanings set out below. Other capitalized terms are defined where they first appear.

A release of the Software designated by a change to the right of the first decimal point (e.g., 2026.1 to 2026.2), including hotfixes and service packs. Updates exclude separately priced new modules.
A release designated by a change to the left of the first decimal point (e.g., 2026.x to 2027.0). Upgrades are included only while a Maintenance Term is current.

Licensee may make a reasonable number of copies of the Software for backup, archival and disaster recovery purposes, provided all copies reproduce Licensor’s proprietary notices. runs.text: This Agreement continues until terminated. Licensor may terminate the license granted in Section 2.1 if Licensee materially breaches Section 5 and fails to cure within fifteen (15) days of written notice, or breaches any other material term and fails to cure within thirty (30) days.

Upon termination of the license, Licensee shall cease all use, de-install the Software from all systems, and certify destruction within thirty (30) days. Sections 1, 5, 7.1, 8, 9, 11 and 12 survive termination.

Each Party shall protect the other’s Confidential Information with at least the care it uses for its own similar information, and not less than reasonable care, and use it only to perform this Agreement. These obligations continue for five (5) years after disclosure, and indefinitely for the Software and trade secrets.
